args.body:
Hi Alice,

I found the resume template website and a download link, but I encountered some technical issues downloading the file directly. Here's what I found:

The website www.resume-templates.com has a download section at www.resume-templates.com/download_links which links to https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf

However, I'm unable to download the file directly due to system restrictions. 

Would you like me to:
1. Try a different approach to get the template to you?
2. Send you the website URL so you can download it yourself?
3. Help you with something else regarding your resume?

Please let me know how you'd like to proceed.

Best regards,
Emma
